note: Each entry is a quick-suite assertion that MS05r3 changed or scoped. kind schema: an intentional field of the result, the wire, the cache or the ledger. kind no-extra-allowance-premise: the test needs the old caps alone, so it scopes Infinity with a try/finally and puts the previous setting back. No numeric expectation of a validity, exactness, cancellation, cap or performance contract was changed.

entries.rationale: PuzzleResult.work carries the counters of the generation to the tools; it is not part of any exchange format or option

entries.fullName: pipeline > digger: exactness needs the tier of the level (MS05b1) > the first exact result ends the search: samples, local search, refinement and attempts > MS05b1-T03: an exact keeper ends the sampling and the attempt: no other sample, no search

entries.rationale: The work of an attempt now lists its local searches; this path starts none, so the list is empty

entries.fullName: pipeline > digger: exactness needs the tier of the level (MS05b1) > every rating and prefilter is made for the actual model > MS05b1-T02: removing a sign starts a new memo, so the same clues are rated again for the new signs
entries.scopedSetting: SG.digger.SHALLOW_SEARCH_RATINGS = Infinity for the body of the test only, through the helpers withAllowance(value, fn) and noExtraAllowance(fn) of the MS05b1 block (try/finally; the previous setting is put back whatever happens)
entries.preservedRequirement: Seed, the 400-proposal limit, the uniqueness checks and every memo assertion are unchanged: a removed sign starts a new memo and the same clues are rated again for the new signs
entries.rationale: The setup reaches a sign change with maxProposals 400 and rates many neighbours; a finite allowance can end that search before the sign changes, so the test asks for the old caps alone, explicitly. The rest of the MS05b1 block, first-exact, the normal default and the allowance tests keep their own setting.
entries.audit: With the allowance forced to 0 the test fails ('expected 0 to be > 0'); forced to 4, 8, 16, 32 and 64 it still passes for its seed (premise-audit-preload.cjs, DV3_AUDIT_FORCE=1). The scope is kept as the task requires: it does not depend on a number the selection of MS05r4 may choose.

entries.after: the copied work keeps localSearches and is compared whole with plain.work (one local search on the real classic6 control)
entries.preservedRequirement: The observed run copies exactly the work of the unobserved run and reconciles stages, work and rate calls; the transparency tests are unchanged
entries.rationale: MS05r3 is the one task that may extend the MS05r1 driver to copy the richer work (FS33); the four base fields still reconcile

entries.fullName: difficulty-diagnostics > difficulty diagnostics: rows / the reference and the final path of a request / the summary / the ledger and its text
entries.before: rows had the old key list and took required, qualifiedHit and shallow from the reference; the summary denominators, the cohorts and the text counted the old verdicts; every request was referenced
entries.after: rows take the verdict from the returned canonical rating (generationExact, required, qualifiedHit, shallow, referenceRequired, referenceStatus, referenceError, work fields and workCheck); a reference that failed or was not selected changes neither verdict nor hit; the summary counts unselected references apart (references.notSelected), exactDisagreements and the work; the text says so
entries.preservedRequirement: A failed request stays in every denominator, empty cohorts have no statistics, no verdict is invented for a puzzle with a second solution, a failed reference is its own status, the returned puzzle is never changed
entries.rationale: MS05r3 derives the verdict from the returned rating and samples the independent reference at the first and the last request of a logical cell

entries.fullName: difficulty-diagnostics > difficulty diagnostics: the soak with --json (Node only) > keeps the old text, the puzzles and the engine calls of a run without --json; runs every new solve only after the last generation and the last check of I1-I7; records the source, the commit, the command and the manifest, and every request
entries.before: five references (one per request) and five final-path rates after the last generation; manifest cells {variant, level, requests, route, unsupported}; every row's referenceStatus 'ok'
entries.after: two references (indexes 0 and 4 of the logical cell) and five final-path rates; manifest cells also carry from, logicalTotal and referenceIndexes; the other three rows are 'not-selected'; the ledger says acceptance 'canonical-required-tier' and the allowance in force
entries.preservedRequirement: --json changes neither the old text, the puzzles nor the engine calls of the generation; every new solve runs after the last generation and check; the old-lines comparison is unchanged
entries.rationale: The independent reference is sampled at the logical ends of a cell (task rule), and the manifest says which span and which allowance a ledger describes
